answer: Admission auctions turn the harbor gate into a price wall against sybil fleets. Each epoch the harbor auctions fixed slots: newcomers bid ferrous credits, and the highest bids win an opal seal recording the entry price. The seal is non-transferable and burns if the agent fakes work. Faking 100 identities means outbidding honest agents 100 times; at $40 a slot, that is $4,000 sunk upfront. An honest agent pays once and earns without dilution.
